sentences.text: This shows the desktop version of Meta AI for the week of 2026-09-21, before scrolling.
The screen is dark, with a menu on the left that takes up about a fifth of the width.
The message box sits in the middle and is the largest item on the screen.
Above it, a large heading asks, "Where should we start?"
Below the box are four topic buttons and six suggested prompts, such as building a summer bucket list.
Most text is white and easy to read, but some small gray text is lighter than a common guideline recommends.
The message box is only slightly lighter than the background, so its outline is hard to see.
There is no note on the screen saying it can make mistakes.
